addr: 2, Ashoka Pillar Rd, 2nd Block, Jaya Nagar East, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: Had my sangeet hosted here. The event went well , the staff were very friendly and co-operative. We were not sure about the food taste as it was our first time here but i would say the food was amazing and everyone loved the food. Had a great time.

The experience of 3 days in the camp in this hotel was very good, the staff is very cooperative and the ambience is nice, food quality was good, Raghu, Vinod and Mantesh were very helping in giving their services, prompt in delivering any type of services, needed in the hotel.

Got here for a most important day of my life. Very nice hospitality, good food and amazing staff. Special thanks to Mr Vinod and Mr Raghu for all the efforts they put in to make sure everything went well.
